title: Nourishing Flaky Turkish Beans Pilaf
description: A funky and flaky one-pot Turkish dish featuring beans and shio-koji cure, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This egg-free friendly recipe is cooked to perfection in a ramekin.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the soaked and drained navy beans, shio-koji, olive oil, chopped onion, minced garlic, turkish spice blend, and salt, and mix well.
Add the water to the bowl and stir to combine.
Spoon the bean mixture into a ramekin, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Roll out the flaky pastry dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Place the pastry dough over the ramekin, pressing the edges to seal.
Cut a few slits in the top of the pastry to allow steam to escape.
Bake the pilaf for 35 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.
